from scipy.optimize import least_squares
cands={
 'P(a+bP)(c+d sqrt t)': lambda p: P*(p[0]+p[1]*P)*(p[2]+p[3]*np.sqrt(t)),
 'P(a+bP)(1-exp(-c t))+d': lambda p: -(P*(p[0]+p[1]*P)*(1-np.exp(-p[2]*t))) + p[3]*0,
 '-a P^b t^c (1+d P)': lambda p: -p[0]*P**p[1]*t**p[2]*(1+p[3]*P),
 '-(aP+bP^2)(c+d t)^e': lambda p: -(p[0]*P+p[1]*P**2)*(p[2]+p[3]*t)**p[4],
 '-(a P^2 + b P) log(1+c t)': lambda p: -(p[0]*P**2+p[1]*P)*np.log(1+p[2]*t),
 '-P(a + b P)*t/(c+t)': lambda p: -P*(p[0]+p[1]*P)*t/(p[2]+t),
 '-a P^b (1+c t)^d': lambda p: -p[0]*P**p[1]*(1+p[2]*t)**p[3],
}
for k,f in cands.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(12):
        p0=np.random.default_rng(s).uniform(0.2,2,5)
        try:
            r_=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-dP_dt, p0)
            if best is None or r_.cost<best.cost: best=r_
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(k, np.round(best.x,4), 'nmse', np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
